thread:
Jackie: Quick follow-up thread for the security/compliance section in today's all-hands. I'm capturing action items.

Omar: Thanks Jackie. Customer asked: when will SOC2 Type II be publishable for hosted API? Need a firm ETA for procurement.

Priya: Update: control period started in Feb. We're targeting a published hosted SOC2 Type II report by early Q4. Dedicated/private will have separate attestation timelines.

Elena: Can Sales get a one-liner status they can paste in RFPs?

Jackie: Yes  I'll draft a short status blurb and post to #sales-ops within 48 hours.

Marcus: VPC/export question: at GA will we support push to customer S3 and a streaming option?

Priya: GA plan: structured JSON events, push to S3/GCS, and streaming via Kafka or PubSub for enterprise. Console shows recent 90-day view; customers must export for long-term retention.

Omar: Is there a programmatic API to request historical audit bundles?

Priya: We'll expose a REST export endpoint and a support-backed historical export for the preview; full API access for Dedicated customers in GA. Spec to be published in docs in ~10 days.

Elena: BYOK timeline? Customers want cloud KMS BYOK + HSM later.

Priya: Current: managed envelope keys live. Cloud-KMS BYOK preview ~810 weeks. HSM-backed BYOK with rotation controls aimed for 4 months after that, contingent on legal.

Security Bot: NOTICE: BYOK onboarding requires the BYOK intake + risk assessment: https://redwood.internal/security/byok-intake

Marcus: Who handles ad-hoc SOC2 evidence requests? Sales needs a contact.

Jackie: Primary: Priya, backup: Elena. We'll provide a redacted evidence pack; deep diligence handled by Security + Legal.

Omar: Runtime question: will audit events include model id, request_id, token counts, and latency?

Priya: Yes  planned fields: request_id, model_id, region, tokens_in/out, latency_ms. We'll version the schema and notify eng-runtime.

Jackie: Leadership asks: 1) Jackie to post sales blurb in 48h. 2) Priya to publish log schema draft in 10 days.

Priya: Acknowledged.

Security Bot: THREAD NOTE: follow-ups captured on Security board.
